dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: A book... Big Nine wrote it specially for me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I was playing with Big Nine before, he said he had a book for me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I started reading it and got really into it... I was so into it that I didn't even notice when Big Nine left.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I went to look for him but then I fell in the river... I made it out, finally, but then I lost the book...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, can you help me look for it? That book's really special to Big Nine, if I lose it he will be really sad.
